content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for DLSA Amroha Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: . Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 30-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DLSA Amroha Para-Legal Volunteer posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the DLSA Amroha Para-Legal Volunteer posts is 30th September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance of the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Para-Legal Volunteers in DLSA Amroha?
faq.answer: There are a total of 19 vacancies for the post of Para-Legal Volunteer announced by the District Legal Services Authority Amroha.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification required is passing the Secondary examination and having good knowledge of Hindi in the Devanagari script.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for the DLSA Amroha Para-Legal Volunteer posts?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application for these posts?
faq.answer: The application process for the DLSA Amroha Para-Legal Volunteer posts is offline. Candidates need to download the form and submit it via post.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Para-Legal Volunteer role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Para-Legal Volunteer posts will include an Interview, followed by Merit consideration and Training.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for the Para-Legal Volunteer position?
faq.answer: The job type for the Para-Legal Volunteer position is contractual.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the Para-Legal Volunteers be posted?
faq.answer: The Para-Legal Volunteers will be posted at the District Headquarters Amroha, Tehsil Amroha Sadar, Tehsil Naugawan Sadat, and Tehsil Hasanpur.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates from outside Uttar Pradesh apply?
faq.answer: The notification specifies DLSA Amroha, Uttar Pradesh. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for any domicile restrictions.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be accessed through the links provided in the 'Important Links' section of this article.
